lines.text: Before reading this book a couple of years ago, I had not met a memoir I could get through. This book changed that. Nezhukumatathil's prose is lyrical-she's a poet, and you can tell. She doesn't shy away from hard topics, but every essay is filled with an undeniable warmth. Even if you don't like reading non-fiction- pick this up. Good if you like Poetic Prose Fireflies The Natural World Joy-Focused-Essays Alba Recommends
